description:
You are the Security Lead at an open source foundation that maintains several widely-used developer infrastructure projects. Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

A critical vulnerability has been privately reported to your security team in one of your core libraries. Your team channels contain initial triage notes and researcher communications. The vulnerability affects a significant portion of the downstream ecosystem and requires coordinated disclosure before public announcement.

You must manage the full responsible disclosure workflow: coordinate a private patch review with your core maintainers, notify the major downstream consumers under embargo, establish a synchronized public disclosure timeline, communicate with the security researcher, and ensure your incident documentation meets the foundation's disclosure policy requirements.
